dedupe_keys.name: dataset and code for bayesian spline method for assessing extreme loads on wind turbines

description: Lee, Giwhyun and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. The deposit supplies J48 code and a separate J48 data archive for the 2013 Bayesian spline extreme-load study. The code establishes an implemented statistical model. The data archive is close in size to the DSWE bending-moment book collection but has a different native checksum, so exact observation overlap remains unresolved. It is retained as supporting model data without a second independent measurement claim. The separately documented bending-moment collection preserves measured and simulated roles. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. The source establishes an implemented or evaluated model. Public source-code availability remains unknown unless explicitly identified below. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance. The model accompanies a study-specific data archive whose measurement overlap is unresolved.
